name: TESS SPOC light curves
description: Local TESS SPOC light curves for the desktop prototype. The application includes no observations or private research records.
grain: One light-curve file for one target and sector.
coverage: Only files that the user imports into this separate workspace.

access.method: Import existing SPOC 120-second light-curve files through the desktop menu.

acquisition.scope: Archive acquisition is outside this prototype. Imported files stay in this workspace.
